scheduler.$description: Scheduler: the bar, the day views (the head with the dates and the all-day panel, the time ruler and the cells), the month view, the timeline views (the scale, the resource column, the rows), the agenda, the appointments, their tooltip and "+N more". The sizes, the layout values and the shares that mix an appointment's own colour into its fill, text and edges are plain tokens; every other piece is a unit (`$units`).

month-date-align.$description: Where a month cell's day number stands: start, center or end.

state-inset.$description: How far the load state stands from the corner, and its padding.

timeline-cell-width.$description: The least width of a timeline's cell along the time (the cells stretch to fill the room when they are few).

timeline-resource-width.$description: A level of a timeline's resource column.

timeline-lane-size.$description: A lane of a timeline row: an appointment's height there (the lanes stand `lane-gap` apart).

timeline-row-min-height.$description: The least height of a timeline row, with no appointment in it.

agenda-time-width.$description: The agenda's time column, the rows' times lined up in it.

appointment-foreground.$description: The text an appointment's colour is mixed into (`appointment-text-mix`).

appointment-text-mix.$description: How much of the appointment's colour its text takes (0: the text colour alone).

appointment-text-auto.$description: How much the text of a box (its title and its time) takes black or white, whichever stands out more on the box's fill as it is now (at rest, under the pointer, open): 100 for boxes filled with the appointment's own colour, 0 to keep the text colour. Either way the text is then made darker or lighter just as far as it needs to read on the fill (4.6:1), whatever the colour.

appointment-time-tone.$description: An appointment's time at rest, under the pointer (`-hover`) and open (`-open`), read on the fill as the title is.

appointment-frame-color.$description: A box's four edges: each one's width and how much of the appointment's colour it takes (0: this neutral frame colour; 100: the colour).

appointment-open-tint.$description: An open appointment (its tooltip showing): how much of its colour is laid over the box's fill (0: unchanged; 100: the colour).

appointment-open-color.$description: The text of an open appointment, laid over its text and time by `appointment-open-color-mix` (0: unchanged).

appointment-open-edge-color.$description: The edges of an open appointment, laid over each edge's colour by `appointment-open-edge-mix` (0: unchanged).

appointment-top-width.$description: The top edge of a box, and how much of the appointment's colour it takes (a stripe on top).

appointment-start-mix.$description: How much of the appointment's colour the start stripe takes.

appointment-continued-start-width.$description: The start edge of a bar that goes on from before what is shown.

chip-background.$description: A month view's chip (a timed appointment in a day): its fill and four edges, as a box's.

chip-color.$description: A chip's text: this colour, taking `chip-text-mix` of the appointment's (0: this colour alone).

tooltip-frame-color.$description: The tooltip of an appointment: its four edges, as a box's.

more-item-frame-color.$description: An item of "+N more":       its four edges, as a box's.

today-button.$description: Today, in the bar (its size is the bar's).

step-button.$description: Previous and next, in the bar.

title-button.$description: The range in the bar, opening the calendar: its variant and type.

view-button.$description: A view in the bar (pressed: the current one).

tooltip-button.$description: Edit and Delete in the tooltip.

tooltip-popup.$description: The tooltip's popup: its padding adds to the tooltip's own.

scheduler.$description: The whole scheduler: its frame, corners, fill and text.

bar.$description: The bar over the views (the kit's toolbar): Today, the steps, the title, the views; a line under it.

head.$description: The day views' head: the dates and the all-day panel; a line under it.

date.$description: A day's head in a day view: its weekday and its number.

day-number.$description: A day's number, in a day head, a month cell (`month`), a timeline's scale (`scale`) or the agenda (`agenda`); `today`, `outside` the month. Its size: `date-number-size`, `month-date-size`.

all-day.$description: The all-day panel; a line over it.

hour.$description: An hour on the time ruler.

time-row.$description: A row of time cells: the line over it (`hour`: the row an hour starts).

cell.$description: A cell: a time slot, an all-day cell or a month day (`month`), a cell along a timeline's time (`line`: the first of an hour `line-hour`, of a day `line-day`); today's column, off hours (of its group's resource, else the scheduler's), a holiday, outside the month, a weekend, the first day of a week row; in a blocked time (`blocked`); a past day (`past`: a layer over its fill); under the pointer, selected, focused by the keys.

now.$description: The line at the time it is now, over its day; in a timeline it stands, across the row (written lying: its height is its thickness).

now-dot.$description: A dot at the start of the now line; in a timeline it stands, across the row (written lying: its height is its thickness).

weekdays.$description: The month view's head: the weekdays; a line under it.

weekday-name.$description: A weekday in the month view's head.

week-row.$description: A week in the month view: the line over it (`first`: none over the first week).

appointment.$description: An appointment's box (`timed` in a day, a `bar` over the all-day panel or a month week, a `chip` in a month cell, a `line` on a timeline row's lane): its space, text size, corners (a piece that goes on before or after: `timed-before`, `bar-after` …), focused by the keys, disabled, one that can be dragged, the box being moved (`draft`), one that cannot go where it stands (`invalid`), one being saved. Its fill, text and four edges mix its own colour by the plain `appointment-*`, `chip-*` shares.

appointment-content.$description: An appointment's text and time (`row`: side by side, in a bar, a chip, a timeline's lane or a short one).

appointment-time.$description: An appointment's time (`hover`: the box under the pointer, its fill deeper; `open`: while its tooltip shows). Its colour is the plain `appointment-time-tone*`, read on the fill.

dot.$description: A dot before a chip's text, in the appointment's colour.

tooltip.$description: An appointment's tooltip: its space and width (its edges mix the appointment's colour by the plain `tooltip-*` shares).

swatch.$description: A swatch in the appointment's colour before the title, on its first line.

tooltip-detail.$description: The tooltip's time (and its time on the appointment's own clock), its lines of resources and its description.

tooltip-resource-label.$description: The name of a kind of resource on its line of the tooltip ("Room"), before its items.

tooltip-resource-item.$description: A resource item on its line of the tooltip: its colour (`resource-swatch`) and its name.

tooltip-repeat.$description: The tooltip's line on how the appointment repeats (`exception`: that it was changed apart from its series).

series-mark.$description: The mark of an occurrence of a series (a repeat glyph, by its `icon`): in a `bar`, a `chip`, an `open` box, a `past` one, a `disabled` one. At the end of the box, the height of a line of its text (the glyph is centred in it); in the box's text colour. None unless a language draws it (`recurrenceMarks: false` leaves it out too).

exception-mark.$description: The mark of an occurrence changed apart from its series (a repeat glyph struck through), in the same places. At the end of the box, the height of a line of its text (the glyph is centred in it); in the box's text colour. None unless a language draws it (`recurrenceMarks: false` leaves it out too).

more-item.$description: An appointment in the list (`hover`, `focus`; its edges mix its colour by the plain `more-item-*` shares).

group-header.$description: The head of a group over its columns: a resource item (the room, then the person under it). `inner`: a level under the outermost; `month`: in the month view. Its text is the unit's, the item's colour a `group-swatch` before it.

group-swatch.$description: The colour of a group's resource item, before its name (a dot, a square, a bar). None unless a language draws it.

group-divider.$description: The line between groups, down their heads and cells, on the start edge of a group's first column (by date: of a day's first column); `inner`: between items of a level under the outermost (by date: between the groups of a day); `head`: its part over the heads. Centred on the column's edge. None unless a language draws it.

unavailable.$description: A layer over a cell in a blocked time (a hatch, a tint), over the cell's own `blocked` fill; `month` and `all-day` for a whole day. None unless a language draws it.

drop-mark.$description: The mark on a box being moved where it may not go (a glyph, by its `icon`): at the start of the box, the height of a line of its text; in a `bar` and a `chip`. None unless a language draws it; the box itself is the `appointment` unit's `invalid` state.

resource-swatch.$description: A resource item's colour in the form's pickers (in the place of an option's icon) and in the tooltip (`tooltip`): a dot, a square. None unless a language draws it.

timeline-row.$description: A row of a timeline (a group of resources, or the one row without groups): the part along the time, under its cells, and the line over it (`first`: the first row).

timeline-divider.$description: The line over a timeline row where an item of the outermost groups starts (`inner`: where only an inner one does), across the resource column and the cells; centred on the row's edge. None unless a language draws it.

resource-cell.$description: A cell of a timeline's resource column, staying at the start while the time scrolls: an item of the row's group at one level (`inner`: under the outermost), and the line over it (`first`: the first row); `continued`: the same item as the row above (its name stands on its first row, and no line parts them).

timeline-corner.$description: The corner over a timeline's resource column.

timeline-corner-label.$description: The name of a kind grouped by, over its level of the resource column.

scale.$description: A timeline's head over its cells (staying at the top while the rows scroll): its fill and the line under it.

scale-upper.$description: A cell of the scale's upper tier: a day over its hours, a month over its days; `today`.

scale-lower.$description: A cell of the scale's lower tier: an hour over its cells (`day-start`: a day's first), a day of the timeline month (`day`, `weekend`); `today`.

agenda.$description: The agenda: the list of its days.

agenda-group.$description: A day of the agenda (in a group): its head and its rows, and the line over it (`first`: the first day).

agenda-resource.$description: The head of a group in the agenda (its resources' names), over its first day.

agenda-day.$description: A day's head in the agenda: its number (the `day-number` unit's `agenda`), its weekday and its month; `today`.

agenda-weekday.$description: A day head's weekday in the agenda; `today`.

agenda-month.$description: A day head's month and year in the agenda.

agenda-row.$description: An appointment in the agenda: under the pointer, focused by the keys, selected (the focused one), open (its tooltip showing), ended (`past`), disabled.

agenda-content.$description: An agenda row's time, colour and text, side by side.

agenda-time.$description: An agenda row's time, as wide as `agenda-time-width`.

agenda-dot.$description: The appointment's colour before its text (a dot, a bar). None unless a language draws it.

agenda-empty.$description: What the agenda says when its days have no appointments.

state.$description: What the scheduler says while it loads or failed (`danger`).
